phases.name: Ground — durability and truth
phases.note: One clean create → restart → unlock → save → restart cycle on real hardware. Five field bugs found and fixed; every one was an integration fault no unit test could see.

phases.name: Substrate — node envelope + event log
phases.note: Schemas done (provenance and mode required). The append-only event log is not built, and it is what everything above waits on.

phases.name: Module contract — decoupling
phases.note: Spec and one manifest written; nothing loads it. Voice-lattice logic is clean (0 DOM refs in 3 of 4 files); its UI lives in the 6,500-line monolith.

phases.name: Lattice primitives
phases.note: Auto-tag, association with speech-tuned stopwords, loop detection, word bank, seeds. Better than v7 — 4% edge density on content words vs v7's 33% hairball.

phases.name: Lattice interface
phases.note: Capture surface: orb with three rings, live waveform from real amplitude, always-visible force-directed lattice, three-column layout. Detail panel (full content, associated nodes by score, delete), node-list filters (domain, word-cloud click, live search), and a heuristic phrase tester that dry-runs the real matcher without touching fireCount/lastFired. 33 tests render the real panels.

phases.name: Capture transport
phases.note: Local Whisper, ordered buffer, voice-note and video import, YIN pitch, clarity, voicing. Delivers into the lattice.

phases.name: Lexicon and grammar
phases.note: PPMI context vectors, tag-transition grammar, ambiguity reduction, Whisper prompt seeding. Abstains below ~200 utterances.

phases.name: Taxonomy — mapping intelligence
phases.note: Classifier seeded from your March corpus. Domain, intelligence, intuition, reasoning. No map view and no correction UI, so it currently learns from nothing.

phases.name: AI as navigator
phases.note: Contract, schemas, options and 37 tests done. No transport — nothing calls a model. Its job is reducing decisions, not generating content.

phases.name: The bridge — cross-module flow
phases.note: v7 had this working. Tags become the system-wide index: one vocabulary, every module reading it.

phases.name: Heuristics library
phases.note: Content salvaged. saveClusterAsHeuristic is the closed loop and nothing currently does it. Every heuristic carries its counter.

phases.name: Ideation — spatial void
phases.note: Add idea → wonder → logic. The screen sequence IS the schema.

phases.name: Compartments — epistemics
phases.note: v7's epistemic register never updates. Adding the review trigger is the whole of Bayesian updating; P6 already detects unresolved beliefs.

phases.name: ALM — feedback loops, compression
phases.note: Nine mutation operators already specified in the salvage, each a pure node→node function.

phases.name: Horizon — embodiment
phases.note: Seeds promote into plans. The obstacle step is non-skippable — mental contrasting, not positive fantasy.

phases.name: Intelligence system
phases.note: The domain map maintained over time, generating open loops from gaps.
